commits.message: fix(daemon): the stats report prints gathers (candybar-launch-q7o7.fqw)
fix(daemon): a click's gathers show in stats, and say what the queue buys (candybar-launch-q7o7.fqw)

fix(daemon): click gathers run one at a time, in no turn (candybar-launch-q7o7.fqw)

Doctor probes share a daemon-wide rate window, so a gather running beside
another session's was refused. The hoisted gather is one step, not a list.

fix(daemon): only a click's first gather runs ahead of its turn; a failed reload re-gathers (candybar-launch-q7o7.fqw)

Review findings: a gather's own step writes, so a later gather stays in the
fold. A reload that fails keeps its config, so error and warning count as the
config changing. A partial rewind counts as a write. No countdown draws while a
click is in flight. The session-queue wait lands on the click event (placeWait).

fix(daemon): read-only doctor gathers run ahead of the journal turn (candybar-launch-q7o7.fqw)

A click joins its session's queue on arrival and keeps its place through
gather and turn; only the daemon-wide turn is taken after the gather. Leading
gathers hoist out of the turn with their failures carried to their position
in the fold, a gather is a snapshot of one config and re-gathers in the turn
when that config changed, and doctor-probe leaves the turn. Idle clock pending
replaces the arrival stamp; handlers lose launcher, doctor and claudeInput.

feat(click): a button's URL says in words what clicking it does (brandon-menus-sjhy.5y2) (#546)

* feat(click): a button's URL says in words what clicking it does (brandon-menus-sjhy.5y2)

A dispatch link leads with a `does` param, derived from the effects the
click fires, so a hover reads `does=set+preset+to+compact` before the
percent-encoded payload. parseEffects reads only `e`, so drawn links and
older daemons are unaffected.

A click's non-session effect is its face, so a confirm reads as what it
fires rather than the disarm that precedes it. `does` is form-encoded and
loses no character; only copied text is shortened. The diagnostics viewer
passes its words, because the position it shows exists only at draw.

* fix(click): a disclosure opens in the words it closes in (brandon-menus-sjhy.5y2)

Review high on PR #546.

- A disclosure's open member reads `open candybar.menu`, matching `close
  candybar.menu`. DISCLOSURE_OPEN replaces three spellings of "open".
- A namespace strips only as a prefix: `my.menus.x` no longer reads `my.x`.
- step-state is a session write, so it no longer outranks what a click fires.
- A repo-config answer reads `mark config in <dir> approved`, an action rather
  than a finished state.
- EffectVerb derives from SAYS, one list instead of two.
- viewerLink requires its words, so a close cannot read as `open diagnostics`.

* fix(click): an authored key reads as itself, and the codec stays off the loader (brandon-menus-sjhy.5y2)

Review medium on PR #546.

- Only a synthesized key is a disclosure: an authored `prFilter` written
  `closed` reads `set prFilter to closed`, not `close prFilter`.
- The viewer's closed value moves beside its key, so a close derives
  `close diagnostics` and ✕ needs no caption of its own.
- The namespace constants and isReservedName move to config/reserved-names,
  a leaf, so wire.ts no longer pulls in the loader's modules and json5.

* fix(click): regenerate the spine bytes and finish the namespace move (brandon-menus-sjhy.5y2)

Second review high on PR #546.

- The spine snapshot still pinned the old door wording, failing CI.
- design-docs/settings-menu-map-render.mts still imported SETTINGS_NS from the
  loader module; no tsconfig covers `.mts` under design-docs.
- HELP_OPEN and the viewer's `go` wrapper add nothing now, so both go.

gitaculous already shows the location, so the default layout drops directory

The default identity row and five bundled presets (compact, verbose, zen,
git, dense) still placed `directory` beside `gitaculous`, which now draws
the checkout path itself. Every default user saw the path twice. The
directory segment stays defined in the library; only its placement goes.

Tests that read the bundled layout now name a segment the bar still places,
and the doc fence shows the one path it renders.

Known consequence: `zen` now holds only `context`, so it no longer shows
where you are. Its comment still describes the old intent.
